text.more:
This is the knowledge graph of the scoping review of my Ph.D. thesis - The Pubic Health Value of The Public Library. The scoping review includes 790 entries of 621 unique articles, covering the dimensions where public health and public libraries intersect:
Health
Physical health
Social well-being
Social infrastructure
Mental health
Learning and education
Science engagement
Sustainability
Urbanism
Evidence-based design
text.intro: Knowledge graph of the scoping review for Anna Au's Ph.D. thesis - The Public Health Value of The Public Library
